verdict.rationale: Proton Pass has its own desktop app support page, which documents offline access to everything in your vaults and vault organization within that app. TOTP generation is documented only generally, not specifically for the desktop app. Community comments saying there is 'no desktop app' come from launch-era threads and are contradicted by the current desktop-app documentation, so they read as outdated rather than as a concrete dispute. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that TOTP codes appear in the desktop app, detail on desktop feature parity and platforms, and independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile

citations.quote: You don’t need to do anything to access Proton Pass offline. Everything in your vaults is accessible whether you’re connected to the internet or not.
Vaults can be used to organize items — in the example above, we have a vault for personal items and one for work items.
Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
